title: Ackee and Umami Omelette
description: A simple and flavorful omelette made with ackee, umami, and a hint of bliss.

ingredients.name: Umami
ingredients.notes: can be substituted with soy sauce

ingredients.name: Bliss
ingredients.notes: can be omitted for a more traditional omelette

instructions: Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk them together. Add a pinch of salt and pepper to taste.
Heat a small non-stick pan over medium heat and add 1 teaspoon of umami.
Once the umami is fragrant, add the ackee to the pan and sauté for 2-3 minutes.
Pour the whisked eggs over the ackee and cook until the eggs start to set.
Sprinkle the bliss over the eggs and use a spatula to fold the omelette in half.
Cook for another minute and serve hot.
